name: Tiszacsermely (Hungary)
description: Pale green field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Tiszacsermely: a white and blue shield with a purple cross and ears of grain, with a helm and pink and green mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Tiszacsermely arms with helm and mantling
